---
name: Rule or model improvement / 规则与型号改进
about: Provide evidence for an anonymized task or exact model
---

- User task and output / 任务与交付物（匿名）:
- Actual app/menu model name / 真实菜单型号:
- Tested workspace and effort / 工作区与档位:

- Current rule and suggested change / 规则与建议:
- What was measured vs. assumed / 实测与假设:

Never include keys, account identifiers, transcripts or client documents.
